basic_info.description: This soaring, light-filled, meticulously constructed, dynamic-view home is perfectly situated in one of the coolest parts of one of the most desired neighborhoods in the US. It has easy access to both Cortland st. and Precita Park. Plus it's merely a half-block from beloved Bernal Hill Park, a green space with astonishing views and great urban hikes ... a dog walker's paradise. Seventy -one Bradford, a four bedroom, three bath, open floorplan, view property is a very rare offering. Thoughtful contemporary design, tall ceiling heights, intricate detail and clean lines define this wonderful single family home. Top level finishes throughout. Come see it and get inspired.
